tracks.title: Neon Rain (Main Theme)
tracks.cue: The case opens. Lonely tenor sax over warm analog pads, rain and distant sirens.

tracks.title: The Office
tracks.cue: Late-night investigation. Brushed drums, walking bass, muted trumpet, a ticking clock.

tracks.title: Vela's Theme
tracks.cue: The door opens and she walks in. Slow breathy sax, smoky piano, danger.

tracks.title: The Blue Orchid
tracks.cue: The house band at one in the morning. Sultry swing, clinking glasses, rain outside.

tracks.title: Somebody Else's Rain
tracks.cue: Dolores's song from the stage. An after-hours torch ballad on tenor sax.

tracks.title: Interrogation
tracks.cue: Questions under one lamp. A heartbeat bass, cold piano, long silences.

tracks.title: Gunfight
tracks.cue: Six shots and no cover to spare. Driving synth bass and heavy drums.

tracks.title: The Docks (Final Showdown)
tracks.cue: Storm at the docks. Pounding drums, synth choir, the last stand.

tracks.title: The Glass Saint (Ending)
tracks.cue: The case closes. A lonely sax dissolves into the rain.
